{{Top}}
'''Kanauer Corporation''' was a big mining operation based in the [[Thrugii Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. Their relative distance from the Empire gave them the freedom to control the hiring, level of pay and the punishment of workers or claim jumpers.
